fields.notes: May contain a slash ('legal/privacy', 'vibe-studio/web-app-builder'); routed by a catch-all segment.

fields.name: ctas
fields.notes: Cta = {label, to, variant: 'primary'|'secondary'|'accent'}.

fields.name: sections
fields.sqlType: jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb (or a marketing_sections child table)
fields.notes: Discriminated by `kind`: cards | prose | steps | split | list | notice.

fields.name: status
fields.sqlType: text not null default 'published' check (status in ('draft','published','archived'))

relations.gap: Internal links are hand-written paths; a slug rename breaks them silently. '/forgot-password' is linked from Login but no page with that slug exists.

entities.name: FaqEntry
entities.purpose: One landing-page FAQ, grouped into four tabs.

fields.name: question
fields.notes: Used as the React key and as the open/closed accordion key — two questions with identical text would collide.

fields.name: answer
fields.notes: Several answers assert unbuilt behaviour (admin top-ups, per-user allocations, usage alerts, rollback).

entities.name: MarketplaceStaffPick
entities.purpose: Editorial 'Staff picks' cards on the landing page and the public marketplace.

fields.name: agentId
fields.notes: 'Contract Analyzer' and 'Invoice Capture' also appear as approval agent names, and 'Lead Qualifier' resembles the CRM agent 'CRM Lead Qualifier' — none are actually linked.

fields.name: meta
fields.notes: 'Legal · by Apragya' — a category and a publisher crammed into one string.

fields.name: rating
fields.notes: No review entity exists to compute it.

fields.name: installsLabel
fields.sqlType: integer (store the count; format at render)
fields.notes: An abbreviated string, not a number — unsortable and unsummable.

relations.gap: Staff picks duplicate catalog names with no join.

entities.name: SuiteTool
entities.purpose: One Business Suite productivity tool. 16 rows carrying the per-use credit cost; rendered on /business-suite and in the in-app suite.

fields.name: cost
fields.notes: 2–12 credits. Marketing claims '100+ tools across 16 categories' but only 16 rows exist here.

fields.name: categorySlug
fields.notes: Deep links use ?category=writing|image|development|data (src/lib/appData.ts:181) with no field to match them on.

entities.name: VibeSkill
entities.purpose: One Vibe Studio build skill. 12 in appData; 9 of them also have a generated landing page.

fields.name: artifact
fields.notes: 'Knowledge bot' is the artifact kind for two different skills.

fields.name: slug
fields.notes: Only 9 of the 12 skills have a page slug; 'AI Agents', 'ERP Customisation' and 'Knowledge Bots' have none, so the footer list and the appData list disagree.

relations.gap: Display-name FK.

entities.name: IndustryOption
entities.purpose: The controlled vocabulary behind onboarding step 2 and the landing marquee. Duplicated verbatim in src/lib/landingData.ts:11.

fields.name: name
fields.notes: Stored on the onboarding profile as this display string.

fields.name: pipelineTemplateId
fields.notes: Onboarding claims 'We preload the agent pipeline built for your industry'. The 5 landing pipelines (Lead Qualification, Invoice Processing, KYC Onboarding, Real Estate Property, Order Fulfillment) are unrelated marketing data and do not map to these 7 industries.

relations.gap: Display-name FK; renaming 'Retail & Ecomm' orphans every profile.

entities.name: TeamSizeBand
entities.purpose: The 5 team-size buckets offered at onboarding step 1.

fields.name: code
fields.sqlType: text not null unique check (code in ('just_me','2_10','11_50','51_200','200_plus'))

fields.name: label
fields.notes: Contains an en-dash ('2–10'), so it is unsafe as a key.

relations.gap: Display-name FK.

entities.name: SignupIntent
entities.purpose: The prompt typed into the landing hero, described in code as 'the top of the funnel'. It survives two redirects as a query string, is echoed twice, then dropped.

fields.name: anonymousId
fields.notes: No visitor identifier exists, so an abandoned signup cannot be attributed.

fields.name: source
fields.notes: Chips: 'Build a CRM agent', 'Process this invoice', 'Draft a vendor contract', 'Analyze customer data', 'Automate hiring' (only the first 4 are rendered).

fields.name: convertedUserId
fields.sqlType: uuid references users(id) on delete set null

fields.name: convertedTenantId
fields.sqlType: uuid references tenants(id) on delete set null

fields.name: consumedAt
fields.notes: Onboarding says 'Queued for your first run' but queues nothing.

relations.gap: Lost on any page refresh during signup.

entities.name: ContactRequest
entities.purpose: A sales or support enquiry. Both pages exist and both admit in a notice block that nothing is submitted.

fields.name: name
fields.notes: No form exists, so the field set is unknown — do not invent one.

fields.name: planInterest
fields.notes: Enterprise pricing CTA routes here.

fields.name: status
fields.sqlType: text not null default 'new' check (status in ('new','contacted','closed'))

operations.currentBehaviour: Server component renders <Landing/>; every section reads module-level constants from src/lib/landingData.ts and src/lib/appData.ts. No fetch anywhere in src/.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Serve published marketing content (plans, FAQs, staff picks, app catalog) from the database with ISR, so pricing and the catalog can change without a deploy.

operations.currentBehaviour: setState only, then navigate(`/register?intent=${encodeURIComponent(intent)}`). Nothing is stored; an empty prompt navigates to /register bare.
operations.requiredBehaviour: POST the prompt as a SignupIntent tied to an anonymous visitor id, return its id, carry the id (not the raw text) through signup, and mark it consumed when the first run is queued.
operations.validation: Trim only. No length cap — an arbitrarily long prompt goes straight into the URL.

operations.currentBehaviour: navigate to /register?intent=<chip label>. Only suggestionChips.slice(0,4) render, so 'Automate hiring' is unreachable.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Same as the hero form, with source='suggestion_chip' and the chip id recorded.

operations.currentBehaviour: setAnnual(boolean) — local state. Swaps which pre-formatted string the card renders. 'Save 17%' and '2 MONTHS FREE' are hardcoded and not derived from the two prices.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Read monthly and annual amounts as numeric(18,4) with a currency, compute the discount, and carry the chosen interval into checkout.

operations.currentBehaviour: A <Link> to plan.cta.to — '/register' for Starter and Pro, '/contact-sales' for Enterprise. The selected plan is not carried anywhere.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Carry the plan code and billing interval into registration so the tenant is created on the intended plan.

operations.currentBehaviour: setGroup(index) — setState only. The open accordion key is not reset when the group changes, so switching groups can leave every item closed.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Read grouped, published FAQs from the database.

operations.currentBehaviour: setOpen(question text | null) — keyed on the question string.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Key on the FAQ id.

operations.currentBehaviour: setActive(index) over the 6 hardcoded agentStudioCapabilities; swaps a detail panel. setState only.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Content-managed section rows.

operations.currentBehaviour: setActive(index) over 5 hardcoded pipelines, each with 6 nodes and 3 stat cards. Purely presentational; no pipeline exists in the product.
operations.requiredBehaviour: If these are meant to be real preloadable templates, they need a PipelineTemplate entity keyed to IndustryOption. Today they are unrelated marketing copy.

operations.currentBehaviour: Pushes the question and an immediately-generated canned string into local state: "On the live site Vippy answers '<text>' from Apragya's own docs." No network call, no persistence, no credit spend.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Either a real RAG endpoint over public docs with a stored conversation, or remove the input.

operations.currentBehaviour: setPreference('light'|'dark'|'system') → localStorage via src/lib/theme.tsx, applied pre-hydration by an inline boot script.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Acceptable as a per-device preference, but if it must follow the user across devices it needs a user_preferences row.

operations.currentBehaviour: setMoreOpen toggle over the 7 hardcoded moreLinks; closes on outside click, Escape, or pathname change.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Navigation should come from published page rows so a slug rename cannot orphan a rail entry.

operations.surface: /[...slug] — 29 routes (vibe-studio, agent-studio, business-suite, enterprise-apps, prompt-lab, trust, integrations, about, partners, docs, blog, help-center, contact-sales, contact-support, solutions, compare, free, legal/privacy, legal/terms, legal/cookies, vibe-studio/<9 skills>)
operations.currentBehaviour: generateStaticParams() enumerates allPages at build time; the handler linear-scans the array and calls notFound() on a miss. Content is a compiled TS constant.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Look the slug up in marketing_pages by (slug, locale, status='published'), with revalidation.

operations.currentBehaviour: Renders <Link to={cta.to}> for each CTA. Targets are hand-written strings; nothing validates that the target exists.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Validate internal CTA targets against the page table at publish time.

operations.currentBehaviour: No form exists at all. The page renders three cards and a notice: 'The live site collects this through a form. This rebuild shows the flow without submitting anything anywhere.'
operations.requiredBehaviour: A real form persisting a ContactRequest(kind='sales') and enqueueing a notification via the existing outbox table.
operations.sideEffect: Needs an outbox topic; the mail transport is unspecified.
operations.validation: Unknown — no field set exists to audit.

operations.currentBehaviour: No form. Notice text: 'Ticket submission is stubbed in this rebuild — nothing is sent.'
operations.requiredBehaviour: Persist a ContactRequest(kind='support'), or create a Ticket in the Support & Ticketing app — the intended destination is not stated anywhere.

operations.currentBehaviour: Builds two in-memory arrays with useMemo: 15 apps, plus one synthetic 'agent' row per app.agents entry (agent names only, with a generated blurb 'Bound to <app> — fires on records as they arrive').
operations.requiredBehaviour: Paginated read of published catalog apps and agents.

operations.currentBehaviour: setFilter('All'|'Agents'|'Apps') — client-side filter of the in-memory array.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server-side filter once the catalog is a table.

operations.currentBehaviour: Case-insensitive substring match on `${name} ${meta} ${blurb}` over every row on every keystroke. No debounce, no pagination.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Indexed full-text search.

operations.currentBehaviour: A button labelled 'Install' that is really a <Link to="/register">. Which listing was clicked is discarded.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Carry the app code into registration and install it on first login, or relabel the control.

operations.currentBehaviour: Validates email format and that the password is non-empty, then calls signIn({email}) — the password is never passed or checked. signIn awaits a 550ms setTimeout, reads localStorage, and returns the stored session when the email matches, otherwise fabricates a brand-new user whose fullName is the email local-part with [._-] replaced by spaces. Writes localStorage 'apragya.session'. Then navigates to session.onboarding ? (location.state?.from ?? '/app') : '/onboarding'.
operations.requiredBehaviour: POST /api/v1/auth/login (already implemented at src/app/api/v1/auth/login/route.ts) — verify the password hash, increment failed_logins, honour locked_until, create a sessions row, set the httpOnly apragya_session cookie, and land the user in their single tenant or ask which one.
operations.sideEffect: none today; server route writes a session row and an audit event
operations.validation: validateEmail + non-empty password (src/lib/validation.ts:25). Any password is accepted.

operations.currentBehaviour: onSso('google'|'microsoft') calls signIn({email: `you@${provider}.com`, provider}) — a hardcoded address. No OAuth redirect, no PKCE, no state parameter, no id_token. Everyone who clicks Google becomes the same account.
operations.requiredBehaviour: A real OAuth/OIDC authorization-code flow with state + PKCE, linking a UserIdentity row. No provider contract exists in this repo.

operations.currentBehaviour: A plain <a href="/forgot-password">. No such route or page slug exists, so the catch-all calls notFound() and the user lands on the 404 page.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Build the screen against the existing POST /api/v1/auth/password/forgot, which already issues a 1-hour token and enqueues an 'email.password_reset' outbox row with a per-hour idempotency key.

operations.currentBehaviour: Server route exists and works (consumes the token, resets the password, revokes every session, clears the cookie). No UI reaches it.
operations.requiredBehaviour: A /reset-password screen that reads the token from the query string.
operations.validation: passwordField — the same policy as registration.

operations.currentBehaviour: Server route exists; registration already enqueues an 'email.verify' outbox row with a 24h token. No UI, and no screen ever shows verified/unverified status.
operations.requiredBehaviour: A /verify screen plus an unverified banner somewhere in /app.

operations.currentBehaviour: Validates 6 fields, checks a honeypot, then calls signUp({fullName, email, organization}) — the password and the terms acceptance are DISCARDED. signUp awaits 550ms, mints a client-side UUID, writes localStorage, and returns. Navigates to /onboarding (preserving ?intent). No tenant, membership, company or audit row is created.
operations.requiredBehaviour: POST /api/v1/auth/register (already implemented) then POST /api/v1/tenants to create the tenant, its primary company and an owner membership in one transaction.
operations.validation: fullName /^[A-Za-z ]+$/; email regex; organization /^[A-Za-z0-9 ]+$/ optional; password must satisfy all 5 rules (8+, upper, lower, digit, special); confirm must match; terms checkbox must be ticked.

operations.currentBehaviour: signUp({fullName: 'New User', email: `you@${provider}.com`, provider}) then navigate('/onboarding'). Bypasses every validation, the terms checkbox and the honeypot.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Real OIDC; terms acceptance must still be captured.

operations.currentBehaviour: setAgreed(boolean). Gate-checks submission and is then thrown away — no terms version, no timestamp, no IP.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Persist accepted_terms_version + accepted_at + ip on the user, since the legal pages are versioned content.

operations.currentBehaviour: A visually-hidden 'website' input; if filled, onSubmit returns silently after validation has already run. Client-side only, so it stops nothing that posts directly.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server-side rate limiting and bot scoring on the register endpoint.

operations.currentBehaviour: useAuth() reads localStorage in an effect; renders 'Loading workspace…' until ready, then <Navigate to='/login'> if there is no session, or to '/onboarding' when requireOnboarding && !session.onboarding. Anyone can forge a session by writing the localStorage key.
operations.requiredBehaviour: GET /api/v1/auth/session (already implemented) reading the httpOnly cookie, with server-side redirects in the route segment rather than a client-side guard.

operations.currentBehaviour: signOut() → persist(null) → localStorage.removeItem('apragya.session'). The workspace blob ('apragya.workspace') is deliberately left behind, so the next person to sign in on that browser inherits the previous tenant's installs, credits, notifications, audit trail and every app record.
operations.requiredBehaviour: POST /api/v1/auth/logout (already implemented — revokes server-side, then clears the cookie) and clear all client caches.

operations.currentBehaviour: next() validates the current step then setStep(step+1). Step state is useState only — refreshing restarts at step 0 with all answers lost. Validation errors render in the workspace-name Field on step 0 and as loose text on step 1; step 2 has no validation.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Persist the draft profile after each step so the wizard is resumable.
operations.validation: Step 0: workspaceName non-blank. Step 1: industry chosen. Step 2: none — zero apps is allowed.

operations.currentBehaviour: On step 0 navigates to '/' leaving a signed-in session with no onboarding; every /app route then bounces back to /onboarding. Otherwise setStep(step-1). The step-0 error is not cleared on back.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Either allow skipping onboarding or make leaving it explicit.

operations.currentBehaviour: setWorkspaceName — setState. Seeded from session.user.organization. No length cap and no character rule (unlike the registration org field, which enforces /^[A-Za-z0-9 ]+$/).
operations.requiredBehaviour: Write tenants.name and regenerate the slug; max 120 chars per the server DTO.

operations.currentBehaviour: setTeamSize(label) — setState, defaults to teamSizes[1] ('2–10'). Stored as a display string and never read again anywhere in the codebase.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Store a band code on the tenant; decide whether it drives seat defaults.

operations.currentBehaviour: setIndustry(label) — setState. Stored as a display string. The copy above it claims a pipeline is preloaded; nothing is.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Store industry_id; if the preload claim is kept, it must create real pipeline/agent rows.

operations.currentBehaviour: toggleApp(code) — setState over an array pre-seeded with ['CRM','HR']. All 15 enterprise apps are selectable, including the gated MFG, IDP and PAY. No quota check, no plan check, no count shown.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Filter or badge gated apps against the tenant's plan and enforce the app quota here as well as in the marketplace.
operations.validation: none — selecting 15 apps against an advertised quota of 3–5 is allowed.

operations.currentBehaviour: apps.forEach(install) — one localStorage write, one audit row and one notification per app, in a loop, non-atomically. Then completeOnboarding({workspaceName, industry, teamSize, apps: <display NAMES>}) writes the session blob with completedAt. Then navigate('/app', {replace:true}). Gated apps install freely; APP_QUOTA is never consulted; a thrown error mid-loop leaves a half-installed tenant.
operations.requiredBehaviour: One transactional call: create/settle the tenant, write the onboarding profile, insert the installation rows, seed the credit pool and trial, emit one audit event and one notification.
operations.validation: Only steps 0 and 1 are validated; the final submit re-validates nothing.

operations.currentBehaviour: Renders 'Queued for your first run: "<intent>"' from the query string. Nothing is queued and the value is dropped on navigation to /app.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Create a real queued job, or remove the claim.

operations.currentBehaviour: useMemo over the three constant arrays, filtered by a substring match on `${name} ${blurb} ${category} ${kind}`. Five tabs: Enterprise Apps (15), Web Apps (2), Mobile Apps (1), Agents (hardcoded count 0), Enterprise Agents (60).
operations.requiredBehaviour: Query catalog_apps joined to the tenant's installations, filtered by surface.

operations.currentBehaviour: setTab. The 'Agents' tab has a hardcoded count of 0 and always renders <EmptyCatalog/> ('No apps available yet — check back later or contact your administrator') while the public site advertises '50+ agents'.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Either populate a standalone-agent catalog or remove the tab.

operations.currentBehaviour: setQuery — client substring filter on every keystroke, no debounce.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Indexed search.

operations.currentBehaviour: 'Latest' (the array's literal order — no date field exists), 'Most installed' (sorts on the editorial installs constant), 'A–Z' (localeCompare).
operations.requiredBehaviour: 'Latest' needs published_at; 'Most installed' needs a real install counter.

operations.currentBehaviour: setView('grid'|'list') — setState, not remembered across navigations or reloads.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Optional per-user preference.

operations.currentBehaviour: setBusy(true) → await setTimeout(800) (comment: 'The live product quotes a 10–20s install; compressed here') → install(code). install() pushes the code onto the array (no-op if present), prepends an 'app.installed' audit row and prepends a notification '<name> Installed — <name> has been installed successfully. You can access it from the Enterprise sidebar.' All in localStorage. APP_QUOTA is never checked, so a tenant can install all 15 against an advertised 5.
operations.requiredBehaviour: POST an installation, enforce the plan's app quota and gating server-side, provision the app's schema/sample data, emit one audit event and one per-user notification, and increment the catalog install counter.
operations.validation: none — no quota, no gating, no plan check.

operations.currentBehaviour: uninstall(code) — filters the code out of the array and prepends an 'app.uninstalled' audit row. No confirmation dialog. Every record that app owns (tickets, assets, posDocs, rfps, appRecords…) stays in the workspace blob and silently reappears if the app is reinstalled. The app also disappears from the sidebar immediately.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Confirm, then decide explicitly between archive-and-retain and purge; either way set uninstalled_at rather than deleting the row.

operations.currentBehaviour: toggleAppDisabled(code) pushes/removes the code in disabledApps and writes an 'app.disabled'/'app.enabled' audit row. disabledApps is read in exactly one place — this button's own label. The sidebar still lists the app, GenericPortal still renders it, and its Run buttons still fire and still spend credits.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Disabling must actually suspend the app's bound agents and schedules and mark its surfaces read-only.

operations.surface: /app/marketplace (gated apps: MFG, IDP, PAY, EVT, RQA, POD)
operations.currentBehaviour: Renders a '⚡ Upgrade' <Link to="/app/account"> with the title 'This app is above your current plan'. /app/account has no upgrade control — only a read-only plan card and a 'Compare plans →' link back to the marketing anchor /#pricing.
operations.requiredBehaviour: An upgrade flow that knows the app's minimum plan and the tenant's current plan. Neither value exists.

operations.currentBehaviour: setAbout(true) opens a dialog listing agentsByAppCode.get(code) — name and blurb only. Web/mobile apps and PPTX resolve to no agents and show 'This app ships without agents of its own.'
operations.requiredBehaviour: Read bundled agents from the catalog.

operations.currentBehaviour: Groups the 60 constant agents by app code and renders them read-only. The 'FIN' group (3 agents) has no matching app, so its header falls back to a generic 🤖 icon. No install, enable or configure control.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Agents should be installable/bindable, or the tab should say they arrive with their app.

operations.currentBehaviour: Reads useAuth().session for the first name and greets by local clock hour. Everything else reads the workspace blob.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server-rendered from the tenant's real state.

operations.currentBehaviour: setTwoFactor('on') — one localStorage write. No secret, no QR code, no verification code, no recovery codes, no audit row. /app/account then reports Two-factor auth: 'Enabled' in green.
operations.requiredBehaviour: A real enrolment: issue an mfa_enroll token (the purpose already exists in auth_tokens), show the secret once, require a verifying code, issue recovery codes, then require the factor at login.

operations.currentBehaviour: setTwoFactor('snoozed') — the banner never returns, because the only render condition is twoFactor === 'pending' and nothing ever moves it back.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Store snoozed_until and re-raise the banner when it passes.

operations.currentBehaviour: Renders the constants TRIAL_DAYS (13) and MONTHLY_CREDITS (1000) plus installed.length/APP_QUOTA (5) and a hardcoded '+ 2 included'. 'Trial' is both the plan name and the status pill. The number never changes for any tenant on any day.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Derive days-left from subscription.trial_ends_at, credits from the current CreditPool, and app slots from the plan's maxEnterpriseApps.

operations.currentBehaviour: 'Manage plan →' <Link to="/app/account">, which offers no plan management.
operations.requiredBehaviour: A billing surface, or relabel to 'View plan'.

operations.currentBehaviour: useMemo builds 5 tasks; 'done' is artifacts.length>0, installed.length>0, and three raw booleans. Because a fresh tenant ships with CRM and HR pre-installed, 'Install an enterprise app' is ticked before the user does anything. The copy claims 'Tasks tick off automatically as you go'.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Derive each task from a real fact; seed-installed apps should not satisfy the task.

operations.currentBehaviour: setFlag('creditsAllocated') — flips one boolean and strikes the row through. No credits move, no amount is entered, no allocation record is written, no audit row.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Open an allocation dialog, write a CreditAllocation against the current pool, and audit it.

operations.currentBehaviour: setFlag('invitedTeammate') — flips one boolean. The row promises "Send an invite — they'll join your workspace in one click." No email is collected, no invitation row is created, no mail is queued, even though POST /api/v1/members already does all three.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Collect an email and role, call POST /api/v1/members, and derive the tick from a pending invitation.
operations.sideEffect: should enqueue an invitation email via the outbox
operations.validation: none today; the server route requires emailField + role enum.

operations.currentBehaviour: navigate(task.to) for the two rows that define one (/app/build/vibe-studio, /app/marketplace). The 'Try the AI Copilot' row defines neither an action nor a `to`, so clicking it does nothing at all.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Give the copilot row a target (it should open the dock, which already listens for the 'apragya:copilot' window event).

operations.currentBehaviour: setFlag('dismissedChecklist') — permanent and irreversible; no control anywhere restores the card.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Store dismissed_at and offer a way back.

operations.currentBehaviour: setTab('overview'|'CRM'|'HR'). The app tabs are hardcoded to CRM and HR — installing any other app never adds a tab (src/screens/app/Overview.tsx:188).
operations.requiredBehaviour: Derive tabs from the tenant's installations.

operations.currentBehaviour: setPeriod(...) updates state and the button's pressed styling, but `period` is never passed to AppMetricsPanel and never read anywhere else. A dead control.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Pass the period into the metrics query, or remove the control.

operations.currentBehaviour: setRange('This month'|'30 days'|'Today'|'All time'); OverviewPanel derives a `since` Date and filters runs client-side by startedAt.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server-side range query.

operations.currentBehaviour: Two <input type="date"> elements with aria-labels 'Range start' and 'Range end', no value, no onChange and no consumer. Typing in them changes nothing. Dead controls.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Wire them to a custom range, or remove them.

operations.currentBehaviour: Apps installed = installed.length with sub `${appQuota - installed.length} slots remaining` (goes negative past 5 apps). Total agents = flatMap of installed apps' agent name arrays, with the sub 'N active' repeating the same number. Runs = filtered local array. Pending reviews = the 2 constant approvals minus decided. Queue = hardcoded '0' / '0 queued · 0 processing'. Credits usage = creditsUsed/creditsTotal.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Real aggregates; the queue tile needs a job queue or should be removed.

operations.currentBehaviour: Returns a hardcoded array: CRM → Deals won 'US$0', New leads '0', Open pipeline 'US$0', Win rate '0.0%'; HR → Active headcount, Joiners, Leavers, Attrition, all '0'. A literal caption 'Amounts in USD. Last updated <now>' makes stale zeros look freshly computed.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Aggregate the app's real records; money as numeric(18,4) with the tenant's currency, not a 'US$' string prefix.

operations.currentBehaviour: window.print().
operations.requiredBehaviour: Acceptable, though a PDF export would need a server renderer.

operations.currentBehaviour: Button labelled and titled 'Alert settings' navigates to /app/inbox, which is a notification list with no settings of any kind.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Build notification preferences, or relabel the control.

operations.surface: /app (Quick Actions, builders, jump cards, AI tools)
operations.currentBehaviour: Static <Link> lists from builderTiles, quickTools and jumpCards. Two of them ('Invite a teammate', 'Invite members') and one ('Allocate Credits') point at /app/account, which provides neither capability.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Point at surfaces that implement the action.

operations.currentBehaviour: Reads notifications and approvals from the workspace blob. Three stat tiles: pending approvals, unread count, and 'Total today' which is simply pending + unread with no date filter at all.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Per-user notification query with real pagination; 'today' must mean today.

operations.currentBehaviour: markNotificationRead(id) sets read:true in the array and rewrites localStorage. The whole row is one big button, so there is no way to open a notification without marking it read, and no way to mark it unread again.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Set read_at for the current user; separate 'open' from 'mark read'; support undo.

operations.currentBehaviour: markAllNotificationsRead() maps read:true over every row. The control only renders while unreadCount > 0; otherwise the header shows the inert text 'Full notifications →' styled like a link but wrapped in a <span> with no target.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Bulk update scoped to the current user; remove or wire the dead 'Full notifications' affordance.

operations.currentBehaviour: Exactly two producers exist: install() ('<app> Installed') and decideApproval() ('<agent> <decision>'). The generic notify(title, body) is exposed on the context and dependency-tracked but is never called from any screen. The list is truncated to the newest 50 on every write.
operations.requiredBehaviour: A typed notification service with categories, per-user fan-out and a deep link; retention by archived_at rather than array truncation.

operations.currentBehaviour: Filters the two module-constant approvals by whether a decision exists in the approvals map. Each row links to /app/approvals; the agent name and summary are rendered as plain strings.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Query real pending approvals scoped to the tenant and the reviewer's permissions.

openQuestions: Trial length and anchor: marketing says 14 days (Landing hero, pricing footnote, /register stat), the runtime constant TRIAL_DAYS is 13 and never decrements. What is the real length, what does it start from (user signup or tenant creation), and what happens at expiry — downgrade to the free tier, read-only, or lock-out?

Credit allowance: MONTHLY_CREDITS is 1000 for everyone, while Starter advertises 2,000/month and Pro 5,000 + add-ons. Which allowance applies during trial? Does the pool reset on a calendar month or the billing anniversary, and do unused credits roll over?

App quota: APP_QUOTA is 5 and unenforced; Starter says 'Install up to 3 enterprise apps' and Pro says 'All enterprise apps'; Overview renders a hardcoded '+ 2 included'. What is the trial quota, and do the two seed apps (CRM, HR) count against it?

Gated apps: MFG, IDP, PAY, EVT, RQA and POD carry gated:true with no plan reference, and onboarding installs them regardless. Which plan unlocks each, and should gating be a minimum-plan foreign key or an explicit entitlement table?

Seats: 'free forever for up to 3 users' (/free, Landing), '5 free seats during trial' (trustPoints, /help-center), 'Up to 10 users' (Starter), 'Up to 25 users' (Pro), and a hardcoded '1 / 1 seats' meter. Which applies when, and is the seat count hard-enforced at invite time or merely billed?
Per-plan build caps — Max Web Apps 3/5, Max Mobile Apps 2/3, Max RPA Bots 3/5 — are advertised but no counter exists anywhere in the codebase. What object is being counted, and against which entity?

Currency: all pricing is in ₹ (INR) with the symbol baked into display strings, while the tenant/company default is USD and the in-app dashboards say 'Amounts in USD'. Which currency does billing charge in, and is the billing currency independent of the tenant's reporting currency?

Is there a fourth 'Free' plan row? Three cards render on the landing page (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) but /free describes a distinct free-forever tier. Does it need its own plan record with its own limits?

Two-factor: what factor is intended (TOTP, WebAuthn, SMS)? Is it per-user or enforceable tenant-wide by an admin? How long should 'Remind me later' snooze before the banner returns? None of this is inferable — the auth_tokens table has an 'mfa_enroll' purpose but no code path uses it.

SSO: which identity providers are actually in scope, is SSO configured per tenant (by email domain) or chosen per user, and does it use JIT provisioning as /trust claims? There is no OAuth/OIDC code to infer a provider contract from.
Identity linking: User.provider is a single scalar ('password' | 'google' | 'microsoft'). Can one account hold several linked identities, and can a password be added to a provider-only account?

Onboarding vocabularies: industry and teamSize are stored as display labels. Should they become reference tables with stable ids, and is the industry list (7 entries, duplicated in two files) authoritative?

Onboarding's industry pipeline preload: the wizard promises preloaded triggers, decisions and integrations. What does that actually create — agent bindings, schedules, connector stubs? The 5 landing-page pipelines are unrelated marketing data and do not map to the 7 industries.

The hero prompt (?intent=): should it be persisted as a lead/first-run job, who consumes it after onboarding, and does an abandoned signup's prompt need to be retained (and for how long, given it may contain business data)?
OnboardingProfile.apps stores app display NAMES while install() takes app CODES. Which is canonical, and should the profile store installation references instead of a name array?

Catalog install counts (2…169 per app) and staff-pick figures ('4.9' rating, '2.4k installs'): are these global marketplace counters, per-tenant counts, or editorial numbers? There is no review or install-event entity to compute either from.
Does uninstalling an app purge its tenant records, archive them, or retain them for reinstall? Today uninstall leaves every record behind and they silently reappear on reinstall.
What should 'Disable' actually do — pause bound agents only, or also hide the app's surfaces and block record writes? Today it changes one button's label and nothing else.

Notifications: only app-install and approval-decision produce one. What are the real categories (the Inbox header mentions @mentions, the dashboard mentions alerts), do they need per-user fan-out with per-user read state, and what retention applies? Today they are tenant-global, share one read flag and are truncated to 50.
The Inbox 'Total today' tile adds pending approvals to unread notifications with no date filter. What window is intended, and in whose timezone — the tenant's or the viewer's?

Audit actor: the client shape stores the literal string 'owner' with an empty IP, while audit_events expects an actor_user_id, actor_kind and IP. Who is the actor for system-generated events, and where does the IP come from in a Next.js deployment?
Role labels: the UI prints 'Org Admin' everywhere while the server model is owner | admin | member | viewer. Which server role does 'Org Admin' mean, and what labels should the other three show?
Billing: there is no payment provider, subscription, invoice or cancellation anywhere. Is one in scope, and does 'no credit card' mean only that the trial needs none while conversion does?
Credit spend attribution: spend() takes only an amount. What reasons, reference types and per-user attribution does the ledger need, and should a failed or cancelled run be refunded?

Contact Sales and Contact Support both state in-page that nothing is submitted. What fields do the real forms carry, where do submissions go, and should a support enquiry create a Ticket in the Support & Ticketing app or land in an external system?

Marketing content: 29 pages, the pricing table, the FAQ set, staff picks and the app/agent catalog are all compiled-in TS constants. Should they move to a CMS (implying draft/publish, locale and link validation), or stay in code and be treated as build-time data?

Compliance and availability claims on the marketing pages — SOC 2 Type II, GDPR alignment, AES-256, 99.9% uptime SLA, HIPAA, region pinning, VPC/on-prem, SIEM export, 'never used to train models' — have no implementation in this repository. None of these should be inferred into a schema or a behaviour; they need product and legal confirmation before anything is built against them.

Legal: all three legal pages state they are summaries and that the operative documents live at apragya.ai. Terms acceptance is collected at registration and discarded — should an accepted-version and timestamp be recorded, and does a new version require re-acceptance?
